evals.prompt: I've already pulled 60 Koala (koala.com, AU mattress/furniture brand) reviews from Trustpilot and ProductReview into /mnt/c/Users/richa/Desktop/mos-geo-skills/.claude/worktrees/mos-geo-review-sentiment/mos-geo-review-sentiment-workspace/inputs/koala/reviews.jsonl. Give me the overall brand sentiment report, a word cloud, and a full ranked report on the areas Koala needs to fix. Don't scrape anything new.
evals.expected_output: Sentiment report with computed headline numbers, positive/negative word clouds (PNG and/or HTML), ranked fix report with verbatim quotes, owners and fixes.
assertions: Headline average rating stated as 2.73 (or 2.7), matching the 60 reviews
Separate positive and negative word cloud files are produced
Word cloud terms are mostly multi-word phrases, not single words
Fix report ranks issues with a review count or share for each
Every quote in the fix report appears verbatim in reviews.jsonl
Report states the sample size and that it is a capped/limited sample
Every quote under an issue in the fix report is actually about that issue

evals.prompt: Find which third-party review sites Bondi Sands (bondisands.com.au, Australian tanning brand) has profiles on, with review counts, ratings and what it would cost to scrape each one through Apify. Don't scrape any reviews yet, I want to pick which sites first.
evals.expected_output: A table of discovered review profiles with review count, rating, latest review and per-platform scrape cost estimate, ending with a request for the user to pick; no review scraping performed.
assertions: No reviews were scraped (no review dataset produced)
Picker/findings table lists at least 3 review platforms including Trustpilot or ProductReview
Each listed platform has a scrape cost estimate in dollars
Each listed platform shows a review count or an explicit unknown marker
Final message hands the platform choice to the user
Paid spend recorded and at or under $0.05
Picker lists regional Trustpilot profiles beyond the AU one (e.g. .co.uk or .eu) with their review counts
